               <milestone n="Lineage" unit="section"/>
               <lb n="N005"/>༄༅ || 'di'i rgyu pa ni | yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sargyas 'phags pa 'ji dpal | slo+on kly grub | zla ba grags pa rig
               <lb n="N006"/>ba'i khu byug ku su lu che ba | ku su lu chung ba j+nya na ma ka ra mnga' riMs kyi phyed zla ba rgyal mtshan rtsong pa rje
               <lb n="N007"/>lung ba | spyil phu ba shes rab grags | spyi bo ltas pa rma bya sakya seng g+he chis na' grags 'jaM dbyangs mgog
               <lb n="N008"/>po | dbu ma bkris rgyal mtshan | suM rtog sangs rgyas bzad po | des dag m'o ||</seg></TEI>
